description: The invariants of a shareable document (E7020 to E7023 in stage 4 and E7024 in stage 5): person counts below min_count, findings that fail the minimum-count or dominance rule, quantiles, labels and ratios, the order in which one value gets at most one issue, and internal documents, to which the invariants do not apply.

cases.description: A shareable document with the disclosure unit 'pupil' whose findings meet every invariant: outcome.boundary_shares writes person counts of at least min_count and their ratios, and structure.cluster_sizes writes the non-person count of the levels of 'school' and the person count of the rows, with its quantiles suppressed: no issue.

A person count of 5 written in a finding that passes both rules: E7020 with the limit of /privacy/min_count. The ratio floor_share, whose numerator it is, would give E7024 in stage 5, which does not run after an issue of stage 4.

issues.message: The person count at /findings/0/statistics/at_floor/value is below the minimum count of 10 and must be suppressed in a shareable document.

cases.description: A support with 8 rows and 9 distinct contributors written: E7020 at each. The finding fails the minimum-count rule, so its written person count 'rows' gets E7021, whereas the non-person count 'levels' stays.

issues.message: The statistic at /findings/1/statistics/rows/value must be suppressed in a shareable document, because its finding fails the minimum-count rule.

The person count at /findings/1/support/rows/value is below the minimum count of 10 and must be suppressed in a shareable document.

cases.description: Quantiles written in a finding that passes both rules: p 0 and p 1 give E7022 whatever n, p 0.5 of 19 values gives E7022 since 19 times 5 is below 10 times 10, p 0.25 of 40 values meets the rule exactly and p 0.9 of 100 values meets it in integer arithmetic, where n times (1 - p) in doubles is 9.999999999999998.

cases.description: constant_share written while its denominator, a non-person count, is suppressed: E7024 concerns person counts only, so no issue.
distinct suppressed with the detail 'secondary', as the filter does across findings: the finding does not fail the minimum-count rule, so its written real is allowed and there is no issue.

A document whose min_count is 5 writes a person count of 7: the invariants of stage 4 use the parameters that the document records, so it finds no issue, and stage 5 reports E7046 at min_count, which the registry gives as 10.

issues.message: The value at /privacy/min_count must be 10, as the privacy block of the registry states.

cases.description: The values of results-shareable-003 with a person count of 3 in an internal document: the invariants apply only to shareable documents, so no issue.

The document of results-shareable-008 with the failing quantiles suppressed and n left out of the quantile 0.9, whose value is written: E7022 at it, since a quantile without n cannot be checked against the quantile rule.

cases.description: constant_share written with the class person while its numerator constant_levels, a by_unit count, is left out: a ratio has the class of its numerator and denominator, so the numerator counts as a person count that is not written, and stage 5 reports E7024, since the ratio and the written denominator multi_row_levels would give it back.

issues.message: The ratio at /findings/0/statistics/constant_share/value must be suppressed in a shareable document, because a person count behind it is suppressed or below the minimum count.
